releases.title: Print category entries to identify the tables
releases.summary: Now you can print the category entries of your competition, so they can be found at tables when participants arrive.
highlights: New redesign of the Last Records found in the home page

releases.title: Auto-stop on the fly and a working unread badge
releases.summary: Organizers can now switch a category's auto-stop on or off even while it's running, and the bell finally lights up when you have unread notifications.
highlights: Toggle a category's auto-stop before it starts or while it's live — it ends on its own when the countdown reaches zero
The notifications bell now shows a red dot when you have something unread, and clears once you've read it
